info.name: Google Cloud Storage JSON BucketAccessControls API
Google Cloud Storage List Bucket Acl Entries

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Retrieves ACL entries on the specified bucket. The authenticated user must have the storage.buckets.getIamPolicy permission.

info.name: Google Cloud Storage Create a Bucket Acl Entry

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Creates a new ACL entry on the specified bucket. The authenticated user must have the storage.buckets.setIamPolicy permission.

info.name: Google Cloud Storage Get a Bucket Acl Entry

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity holding the permission, in one of the following forms: user-userId, user-email, group-groupId, group-email, domain-domain, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Returns the ACL entry for the specified entity on the specified bucket.
